name: Training Mode
desc: God mode, frozen bots, endless ammo and grenades, and zero reload or recoil.

name: God Mode
desc: Enemy fire and blast damage cannot kill P1.

desc: Keeps the active weapon full without consuming reserve ammo.

desc: Throw unlimited live frag grenades with G or gamepad Y.

desc: Freezes bot movement, aim, and firing for safe weapon tests.

desc: Press K to eliminate every live bot in the current match.
